name: Redcap Breaker
description: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.

abilities.name: Backbreaker
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is Restrained until they clear a HP.

abilities.name: Kneecapper
abilities.description: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.
